correctness.rationale: Adding a diagonal weight in (0,1) implements the stated ties without changing nonzero neighbor sums. Symmetry gives E_(t+1)−E_t=−(s_(t+2)−s_t)^T B s_(t+1), strictly negative whenever two-step equality fails; finite energy values give eventual period at most two. Within a periodic state all leaves at a site agree, and an ordered pair of core and leaf words is periodic exactly when both updates swap the words. With one leaf the two conditions mean no isolated bit in the bipartite double cover, which is one cycle of length 2n for odd n and two of length n for even n. The cyclic length-j count is the trace of the four-state consecutive-bit matrix with polynomial (z²−z−1)(z²−z+1). With two leaves a bit matching its leaves always retains that value, even at a tie; a differing bit must have at least one core neighbor matching its leaves, in both phases. The closed-walk trace counts indexed words, not rotation classes. Independently formed the 16-state matrix by literal four-vote majorities in both phases and recomputed its characteristic polynomial symbolically; all factors match, and the first trace counts agree with frozen VERIFY.out. The quartic has two positive roots in (1/2,1) and (3,4), exactly two by Descartes. For z=−u<0 it is positive (if u≥1/3 then 3u³≥u²; otherwise 2−u²>0). The remaining conjugate pair has squared modulus 2/(product of the positive roots)<4/3, and the other factors have moduli ≤sqrt(2); hence the large root governs growth. With r≥3 a monochromatic bundle dominates after one step, and a nonmonochromatic starting bundle is not recurrent, proving sharpness. Fixed points are counted separately and dividing P−H by two counts unoriented primitive cycles. Read VERIFY.py and VERIFY.out without executing the supplied script. Replay the independent matrix construction via `python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py` (section 3; SymPy and mpmath); the finite determinant is exact, while the all-size counting and growth arguments are analytic.
